title: Come Alive (Dry Bones)
lyrics: Verse 1:
Come Alive (Dry Bones) - Akkorde im Text
**Tonart** Am
**Akkorde** Am, F, Dm, C, G, C/E
Verse 2:
[Am]Through the eyes of man it seems there's so much we have lost
[F]As we look down the road where all the prodigals have walked
[Dm]And one by one the enemy has whispered lies and led them off as slaves
Verse 3:
[Am]But I know that You are God, Yours is the victory
[F]We know there is more to come we may not yet see
[Dm]So with the faith You've given us we step into the valley unafraid
Verse 4:
[F]We call out to [C]dry bones, come a[G]live, come a[Am]live
[F]We call out to [C]dead hearts, come a[G]live, come a[Am]live
[F]Up out of the [C]ashes, let us see an [Am]army [G]rise
[F]We call out to [C]dry bones come a[G]live
Verse 5:
[Am]God of endless mercy, God of unrelenting love
[F]Rescue every daughter bring us back the wayward sons
[Dm]And by Your spirit breathe upon them show the world that You alone can save
You alone can save
Bridge 1:
[Dm]So breathe, oh breath of God
[Am]Breathe, oh breath of God
[Dm]Breathe, oh breath of God
[G]Now breathe
alternateTitles: Through the eyes of man it seems there’s
